# OpenDeck

> Turn an old phone into a "Stream Deck"-style companion for your PC. A Rust
> server streams the desktop over WebSocket and injects touch/keyboard input
> back — open source, local-first, for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

- Repository: https://github.com/hieudoanm/open.deck
- Site: https://hieudoanm.github.io/open.deck/
- Protocol: https://github.com/hieudoanm/open.deck/blob/master/docs/PROTOCOL.md
